# 相似、换算与缩放参数

_Similarity, Corrected Quantities & Scaling_

相似分析和换算参数帮助整理不同进口条件下的部件特性。无量纲、准无量纲、带参考基准的换算量，以及用于不同尺寸之间的缩放，表达的对象并不完全相同。

_Similarity analysis and corrected quantities help organise component characteristics at different inlet conditions. Dimensionless groups, quasi-dimensionless groups, reference-based quantities and geometric scaling serve related but different purposes._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 每个参数都记录原始定义、参考温压、单位和适用站位，不仅保存一个缩写。

_Retain each definition, reference pressure and temperature, units and engine station._

- 把实际流量和转速，与换算后的坐标分开；换算并不自动消除雷诺数、几何或间隙等差异。

_Separate physical mass flow and speed from corrected coordinates; correction does not remove every Reynolds-number, geometry or clearance effect._

- 跨发动机尺寸缩放时，明确保留了什么相似条件，以及哪些修正仍需验证。

_When scaling between engine sizes, state the similarity conditions retained and the effects that still need validation._
